corrections.old_text: [፳፫] ር በነبي እንዘ ይብል ፡ ናሁ ድ↵
corrections.corrected_text: [፳፫] ር በነቢይ እንዘ ይብል ፡ ናሁ ድ↵
corrections.reason: OCR script-mixing artifact replaced Ethiopic 'ቢይ' in 'በነቢይ' (Matthew 1:22) with Arabic characters.
The 5th-order 'ኤ' in 'ኤላንሳን' (as in L29 and L31) at the end of the line was misread as 3rd-order 'ኢ'.
The word 'ሥጋዌው' wraps mid-word across lines 29 and 30.
Visual inspection of Col 3 L30 shows 'በብዙ ኅብረ ትንቢት' (construct state matching 'በብዙ ኅብረ አምሳል' on the next line), without a final 'ት' on 'ኅብረ'.
Faint print caused 'የፀሐየ' in the classic Marian epithet 'የፀሐየ ጽድቅ ሰሌዳ ድንግልን' (the tablet of the Sun of Righteousness, the Virgin) to be misread as 'የሥላየ'.
